title: IAM-OS Touch Frame
description: One frame of touch data broadcast by touch-bridge on ws://localhost:8765. Touch contract version 1.0.0 — see docs/touch-contract.md.

seq.description: Monotonically increasing frame counter. Resets to 0 only when touch-bridge restarts.

count.description: Number of active touches in this frame. Invariant: equals the length of `touches`.

touches.description: Active touches in this frame. Empty array when count is 0.

id.description: Stable identifier for the lifetime of a single touch. The same physical touch keeps the same id across frames.

x.description: Horizontal position, normalized to the projection surface. 0.0 = left edge, 1.0 = right edge.

y.description: Vertical position, normalized to the projection surface. 0.0 = top edge, 1.0 = bottom edge.
